speed_vs_time_full_throttle_kmh.desc: [t_s, km/h]: measured to 2.9 s, then measured bands integrated

coast_curve_kmh.desc: [t_s after gas release, forward km/h] coast.csv (road); starts after the 1-tick brake artefact at release

curve_kmh.desc: [t_s after brake press, forward km/h] brake.csv (brake held: stop then reverse)

full_lock_radius_m.desc: [speed_kmh, m] steady full lock, road (below ~80 km/h: ~9.5-10 m)

full_lock_accel_penalty_ms2.desc: [speed_kmh, m/s^2] accel lost vs straight line at full lock

crest_jump_height_m.desc: [t_s since takeoff, height relative to takeoff m] x_crest_off (123 km/h)

meta.what: Feel targets of the TMUF SnowCar, measured from per-tick recordings of the real game (TMInterface, 100 Hz). Observed behaviour only.
meta.units: speeds km/h unless *_ms; accelerations m/s^2 (g = /9.81); angles deg; yaw rate rad/s; 1 tick = 10 ms

materials.14: road (SnowB1 start straight, bridge and track)
materials.21: snow terrain (open snow south of the start, hills)
materials.12: unidentified small surface on a hill face (768-773, 611-614) and near the bridge; car stuck there in reverse

unusable.lpc/lpc_accel.csv, lpc/lpc_accel_left.cs: gas/steer inputs were never applied (gas column 0): car idles on the start line; only the spawn settle is visible
unusable.nadeo_run1.csv: older 44-column recording, replay desynced: crashes into the first-corner barrier at 2.15 s and stays stopped (used only as a wall impact)

meta.deterministic: nadeo, nadeo_finish, nadeo_cam_bridge, nadeo_cam_start give bit-identical positions (same inputs, even at 5% game speed)

artefacts.coast.csv: one-tick brake pulse at t=1.41 s (the script only releases gas): -51 m/s^2 for 1 tick (-1.8 km/h); coast values are taken after it
artefacts.lsx/lsy/lsz columns: car-local speed lagging one tick behind the world velocity; not used (local frame recomputed from the quaternion)

slope_effect.desc: full throttle on a ramp: change of forward accel per unit of slope sine (uphill negative), vs the flat value at the same speed
slope_effect.source: nadeo_finish, x_cp_post, x_crest_off (bridge ramp: slopes up to +-0.45)

accel_vs_speed_bins.desc: [speed_kmh (bin centre), forward accel m/s^2 (slope-corrected), n_ticks, mostly_flat]

accel_bands_road.desc: full throttle, straight, road: forward acceleration is piecewise CONSTANT in speed, with sharp steps (independent of gear); no speed-proportional drag visible

bands.note: seen only 240-242.3 km/h (0.8 s, nadeo_finish 15.0-15.8 s): 0.95-1.05 m/s^2

accel_bands_road.source: accel, taps, coast, brake, steer_*, x_* (flat start straight), nadeo_finish/x_cp_post (flat 140-160 and 230-242 km/h, bridge ramps for the slope term)

measured.desc: [t_s, km/h] accel.csv, flat start straight, until the barrier

derived_from_bands.desc: [t_s, km/h] the measured accel bands integrated on flat road (above 242 km/h: last band assumed to continue)

300_kmh.how: EXTRAPOLATED: assumes the 240+ km/h band (1 m/s^2) continues; never observed

nadeo_real_run.note: real run: steering taps + bridge (downhill before 200 km/h)

top_speed.where: nadeo_finish t=15.8 s, flat, still accelerating (+1.0 m/s^2)

straight_line.gear_note: upshifts do not coincide with accel steps; rpm column is always 0 (not captured)

reverse.top_speed_road_note: limit cycle 150.0-150.4 km/h (x_wall_brake_rev t=4.05-4.7 s): a hard cap
reverse.source: brake (road reverse), x_wall_brake_rev (150 km/h cap), reverse / x_reverse_hill (snow)

wheel_response.note: the 'turning' column moves 0.2 per tick (0 -> 1 in 5 ticks), same on release; 1 tick after the input

yaw_decay_after_release.source: taps, nadeo_finish (wheel back at 0, 4 wheels down, road)

full_lock_steady_road.desc: steady full lock on road (>=0.3 s after lock, yaw rate settled). radius = v / path turn rate; accel_penalty = accel - straight-line accel at that speed (slope-corrected)

full_lock_low_speed.note: below ~80 km/h the full-lock circle has a ~constant radius (yaw rate grows with speed); above, the yaw rate saturates ~2.4-2.7 rad/s and the radius grows ~linearly with speed

slip_angle.desc: slip angle = angle between velocity and car heading, clean ticks (4 wheels down, >20 km/h, moving forward, no impact within 0.4 s)
slip_angle.car_level_sliding_flag: always 0 in every recording (unusable); per-wheel slide flags used instead

accel_full_throttle.desc: flat snow terrain (material 21), gas, slip < 5 deg; forward accel
accel_full_throttle.source: x_snow_donuts, x_snow_uturn_hill (+ other x_* snow ticks)

gas_against_motion_decel_ms2.note: gas while rolling backwards on snow (21 -> 0 km/h), the closest thing to braking on snow in the set (no forward braking on snow was recorded)

full_lock_snow.note: the body keeps rotating at ~the road yaw rate but the path only turns at ~half of it: slip grows ~15-20 deg per 0.1 s -> spin (no steady drift at full lock + gas)

snow.wheel_slide_pattern: wheels 0,1 (front pair) flagged sliding at low speed with full lock + gas (understeer); all 4 flagged once lateral accel saturates (~2.4 g) -> drift/spin. On clean road driving no wheel ever slides.

walls.desc: incidence = angle between the pre-impact horizontal velocity and the wall plane, the wall normal being estimated from the impulse direction (includes friction, +-10 deg). rebound_away_ms = largest speed away from the wall within 0.3 s (0 = no bounce). min_up_y < 0.9 = car tips/climbs the barrier (0 = on its side). recover_80pct_s = time until 4 wheels down and back at 80 % of the pre-impact speed (gas held), null = not within the recording.

events.what: side barrier after a right swerve
full-lock turn into side barrier, no gas
checkpoint gate post at top speed

gravity.note: constant; no air drag measurable, throttle has no effect in the air

angular_damping_air.desc: |angular velocity| during the 1 s flight of x_crest_off: [t_s, rad/s]
angular_damping_air.empirical_fit: dw/dt = -(0.96 w + 1.96 w^2)  (w in rad/s, fitted on 0.2-1.8 rad/s; a description of the observed curve)
angular_damping_air.note: decays faster at high rates; the pitch set at takeoff keeps rotating the nose down over a crest (-4 -> -22 deg in 1.1 s)

real_driving.source: nadeo_finish (author replay of SnowB1, 18.19 s, 3/3 checkpoints; nadeo.csv & nadeo_cam_* are the same deterministic run)
real_driving.input_device: keyboard (steer is -1/0/+1 only): the set has no analog-steering recording

suspension.units_note: wNdamper (DamperAbsorbVal): 0.5 = fully extended (wheel in the air), smaller = compressed. Probably metres of travel (not verified).

spawn_settle.desc: car dropped at spawn then full throttle (accel.csv), front-left damper extrema [t_s, value]

longitudinal_load_transfer.note: none: all four dampers stay equal and the body does not pitch under 30 m/s^2 accel or 51 m/s^2 braking

landing.source: x_ramp_off_left 7.56 s (lands on snow, vy -2 to -5 m/s, rolled 40 deg)

compression_bottom_of_ramp.source: nadeo_finish 9.5-10.6 s (bridge exit, slope -0.44 -> 0 at 190-215 km/h)

suspension.wheel_order: from roll/landing evidence: w0 front-left, w1 front-right, w2 rear-right, w3 rear-left (w1,w2 compress in a left turn; w0 touches first nose-down/left-down)
